title: Steve Justice at To the Stars wanted to know how saucers flew

tellings.quote: Steve Justice, right? >> Yeah. >> And here was a guy who who would know where the bodies are buried, right? >> Yeah. >> And um he didn't know. He he really wanted to know how those saucers flew. >> Wow. >> That's what he told me. He says, "I want to know how they do it."

plain: Steve Justice, who worked at To the Stars Academy, a private venture founded to research UFOs, privately admitted that he did not know how flying saucers flew and badly wanted to find out. Peter Levenda, billed on the show as a CIA historian, tells Michels that Justice told him so directly, sometime between 2017 and 2019: "I want to know how they do it." Levenda's point is that a man he thought "would know where the bodies are buried" was still in the dark, which would mean the secret, if there is one, is held tightly even from insiders.
